title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked Anime Casts Yō Taichi
content: NBC Universal revealed a new cast member for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga (the Japanese manga and anime write the English title as: My mother-in-law and sister-in-law who don't bully me. ) on Monday.
author: ANN

title: "Food Terror Is Coming": Toho Animation Teases August 4 Mystery Anime Announcement
content: TOHO animation has begun teasing a new anime project, with the announcement scheduled for August 4 at 9:00 p.m. JST. Ahead of the reveal, the studio will premiere a “special video” on its official YouTube channel at 8:00 p.m. JST.
author: Anime Corner

title: Garena to Launch Palworld Online Mobile MMORPG This Year
content: Singaporean game developer and publisher Garena Online Private Limited announced on Monday it has officially licensed and is developing a new mobile MMORPG based on Pocketpair's Palworld IP (intellectual property) titled Palworld Online , which will launch this year.
author: ANN

title: 'Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku' Live-Action Film's 2nd Trailer Reveals Theme Song by Radwimps
content: TOHO started streaming on Monday the second trailer for the live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel. The video reveals and previews the film's theme song "Yūzutsu" (Evening Star) by rock band RADWIMPS .
author: ANN

title: Suikoden Star Leap Game Reveals August 7 Release Date in Japan
content: Konami announced on Monday that Suikoden: Star Leap ( Gensō Suikoden: Star Leap ), the upcoming game in the Suikoden series, will launch in Japan on August 7. Konami will release the game for iOS, Android, and PC via Steam , but the Japanese release will only be for iOS and Android starting on August 7.
author: ANN

title: Kami Nishio's 'Still You' from Young Magazine US Starts Serialization on August 24
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web manga website announced on Saturday that Kami Nishio's "Still You" one-shot manga from the special Young Magazine US English issue will launch as a series on the website on August 24. The original one-shot centered on three high schoolers: Reo, Rui, and Momo.
author: ANN

title: Heaven Burns Red Game's Main Story Heads to Final Chapter
content: The staff for Jun Maeda 's ( Kanon , Air , Clannad , Angel Beats! ) Heaven Burns Red game announced the start of its 4.5th anniversary campaign on Sunday, which includes updates, and marks the beginning of the final chapter of the game's main story.
author: ANN

title: My Boy, Gene Bride Author Hitomi Takano Launches New Manga
content: Manga creator Hitomi Takano launched a new manga titled Tomodachi kara de mo Ii desu ka ( Can we start as friends? ) on Shinchosha 's Comic Bunch Kai web manga magazine, on Friday.
author: ANN
